description: Buy a travel/data eSIM using the agent wallet balance (pass the ak_live_ api key from create_wallet). Deducts the plan price from the balance and returns the eSIM QR code instantly. Get a package_code from search_esim_plans first. Pass a stable request_id to make retries safe (no double charge). This provisions a real eSIM - only call it when the user has confirmed the purchase.

api_key.description: The ak_live_ key returned by create_wallet. Pass it here, or as an Authorization: Bearer header.

package_code.description: The plan code from search_esim_plans, e.g. CKH253.

request_id.description: Optional idempotency key - reuse the same value on a retry to avoid a double charge.

name: purchase_esim
